scope: Dynamic modular homes in the surrounding world: paint connected floor regions across camera views; WFC generates compatible floors and shared walls, windows and operable doors; edit individual edges and extend a home while preserving other parts, locks and nested contents; place floor furnishings with position/facing and edit their supported contents including zero counts; walk inside and see outside with shared physical geometry, usable routes, responsive desktop/phone controls, Undo/Redo, persistence and recovery.

intuitiveness.evidence: The critic independently created and extended a home with real pointer gestures, picked visible parts in Overhead/Orbit/Fly/First person, and used touch controls to place a rotated table, descend through tabletop/plate/well/food, lock contents and request zero plates. The repaired phone drawer uses its available width. Look closer, Its contents and Up now frame actual selected geometry and empty supports; Whole home selects the root and restores a structural overview. All four bookcase/support facings are tested. Inspection cutaway handles a wall-adjacent furnishing without changing walking geometry. Tap highlighting, nested-part hints, useful protected-count refusal, exact Undo/Redo and post-recovery selection make the main journey understandable and recoverable. The long phone drawer and transient notices over the subject remain minor refinements.

accuracy.evidence: The complete registered modular scope has source, independent native geometry/admission, and actual Castle/WASM browser evidence. The interleaved WFC graph generates compatible floor/shared-edge values for exact painted footprints, and independent validation rejects bad ownership, incompatible finishes, disconnected/sealed paths, obstructed approaches, intermediate door sweeps, unknown nested geometry and protected mutations. The critic's final native probe passes 27,929 assertions, including 25,921 collision-bin/full-scan comparisons and exact failed-request preservation. Native Castle ray/mesh probes verify the corrected shared terrain/contact surface and chunk seams. Actual UI edits preserve other parts and complete protected descendants, zero removes whole unprotected plate assemblies while retaining forks, and real door walking stays in the exterior world. A real WEBGL_lose_context loss preserves exact world/history/future/selection/nested controller/high-zoom camera, followed by a fresh engine ray selecting the same apple. Finite bounded geometry and current desktop/touch-browser feasibility are demonstrated; these are not claims of universal layouts, hardware or physical-phone performance.

wowFactor.evidence: The result is worth demonstrating: a painted region becomes an editable house in the land, openings show the actual surrounding world, doors admit continuous walking, and the same structure can contain a table, plates and individually selectable food. Actual desktop and DPR2 phone images now show calmer plaster, coherent oak/stone values with physical-scale joints, and readable fine selections. The final obstruction-aware cutaway reveals a bookcase placed close to a perimeter wall and returns that wall when appropriate. This closes the earlier coarse-material, tiny-object and occluded-inspection gaps. The one-storey flat-roof kit and simple repetitive wood treatment are visually modest, but the completed architectural and nested-content interaction is coherent rather than a collection of disconnected previews.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: The useful combination is an interleaved WFC structural graph, independently validated physical routes, stable composition identities and the existing generic nested-support solver in one surrounding-world scene. Exact extension seams preserve a locked fruit several ownership levels below a floor furnishing. A graded foundation apron shares rendered and walking triangles while retaining underlying ecology data under an explicit occupancy overlay. Inspection-specific wall cutaway, selection-aware framing and whole-session admission let the player move between architecture and tiny contents without portal substitution or physics changes. These mechanisms extend the existing pinned WFC APIs without an upstream change and provide practical authoring power.

Repeated full-document validation per empty floor caused large native work. Validation now checks the full document once, skips admitted empty floors and validates populated local subtrees with their ancestors; spatial bins preserve collision results. On the critic's empty 256-floor/802-node fixture, GenerateWorld falls from 33,000 ms to 437 ms, ReadModularBuilding from 5,610 ms to 16 ms and ValidateWorld from 16,531 ms to 156 ms. This is a native workstation comparison, not a phone latency guarantee.

All rendered critic runs use native Pascal tooling and a real desktop Chromium/ANGLE D3D11 renderer on a GTX1080. Phone evidence is actual touch input at a 390x844 CSS viewport/DPR2 on that desktop GPU. It establishes the tested responsive layout and interaction paths, not physical Android thermal behavior, phone FPS, OS discard or universal GPU compatibility.

The documented construction kit is one storey with 2.8 m walls,2 m floor tiles, a flat roof, at most 256 connected tiles and 64 m span. Dry-land support/approach rules can reject a footprint; one primary furnishing occupies each floor tile with finer nested support contents. Animated door motion, stairs, stacked storeys and arbitrary-angle walls are not implemented or claimed.

Original ecology arrays remain exact beneath the modular occupancy overlay; intersecting rendered/colliding vegetation is suppressed while occupied and can reappear after removal. This is intentional layer precedence, not a claim that vegetation still renders through a house.

Selected inspection cutaway is temporary rendering state. Physical collision, saved walls and first-person geometry remain intact. Existing imported houses retain their legacy portal interiors; the new modular homes are actual world-space structures.

Camera coordinates and initial fixture worlds are sometimes set through existing application bindings to isolate a view. Claimed painting masks, part rays, door movement and UI actions use real browser pointer/touch/keyboard input. Baseline01 includes one vacuous incidental worldUnchanged diagnostic and an aimed-away pick; neither is counted as positive evidence. Delta02 includes a nonexistent diagnostic selector and an incorrectly named fork screenshot; corrected routes and original failure artifacts are explicitly retained.

Maximum native empty-home timings and a handful of browser construction samples do not bound every many-home or densely furnished request. Remaining general performance measurement belongs to the separately held performance work.
